content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD 소스 맵 노트 — src/*.F 39파일 직접 read+funwave_tvd_3.0.pdf 변환본 기반의 모듈 구조·실행 흐름·툴 개관(L5). §1 지배방정식·수치기법(L14-L18): 완전비선형 Boussinesq(Wei-Kirby 1995/Chen 2006, reference-level zα 속도, conservative well-balanced form — Shi et al. 2012a Cartesian/Kirby 2012 spherical); MUSCL-TVD finite-volume+adaptive Runge-Kutta+HLL Riemann flux; wetting-drying moving boundary(HLL 결합)와 쇄파 2방식(viscosity+shock-capturing). §2 실행 흐름(main.F 653줄, L20-L28): READ_INPUT(mod_input)→INDEX→INITIALIZATION(init.F)→강제력 init(TIDE/METEO/VESSEL/SEDIMENT/PRECIPITATION/TRACER)→시간루프[ESTIMATE_DT(CFL)→강제력(VESSEL/METEO/TIDE_DATA)→FLUXES(MUSCL-TVD)→dispersion+tridiagonal solve→SPONGE_DAMPING→MIXING_STUFF→OUTPUT(io.F)]. §3 모듈 맵 표(39 .F 역할별, L30-L45): driver main.F(653); flux fluxes.F(2475)·fluxes_21v/33v.F; 분산 dispersion.F(506)·etauv_solver.F(604)·tridiagnal.F(579) — 연산비용 핵심(GPU=cusparse 대상); 쇄파 breaker.F(354); 조파 wavemaker.F(3299, WK_IRR/WK_REG/WK_DATA2D/INI_*); 흡수경계 sponge.F(939, LD+friction+viscous, v2.2 sawtooth 대응); 경계/마스크 bc.F(1275)·masks.F(251); 미분/혼합 derivatives.F(413)·mixing.F(305)·mixing_salatin.F; 병렬/IO parallel.F(547)·mod_parallel_field_io.F·io.F(5064)·samples.F(634)·statistics.F; nesting nesting.F(599)·sources.F; 강제력 모듈 mod_tide·mod_meteo·mod_vessel·mod_sediment·mod_tracer·mod_precipitation·mod_foam·mod_subgrid·mod_bathy_correction·mod_time_spectra; 전역/입력 mod_global(461)·mod_param(93)·mod_input(351). §4 tools/(L47-L52): input_generation/PreProcessing_FUNWAVE.m(도메인 설정·local↔UTM·수심 보간), read_format/read_binary.m·read_nc.m(binary/NetCDF 출력 읽기), plot_googlemap/plot_google_map.m, filter/(후처리). §5 메뉴얼(L54-L57): raw/manuals/funwave_tvd_3.0.md(opendataloader-pdf 변환, gitignore 로컬), doc/ 4문서(funwave_tvd_3.0.pdf 현행·2.1_manual·Intro-to-FUNWAVE-CHL-TN·funwave_code_analysis). §6 연결(L59-L63): README·build-and-blackwell-port(cusparse=tridiagnal 가속)·concepts/waves 06-model-application §1.1·harbor-tranquility-kds64·xbeach_nonh(동일 Boussinesq-type 계열).
